The opening continues a statement that G↦SΠM_G is functorial for arbitrary morphisms and that (124) is functorial for isomorphisms. It supposes the square (125) for a morphism G→G′ corresponding to C⊂A_G. The succeeding text asserts factorisation through the extension denoted S_C M_G, induced by the lattice hom Z^{A(G)}→Z^C, and asserts a transitivity relation for a composite. These are statements being transcribed, not theorems checked in this reading.

The written lower-left target of φ_G in (125) is S_C M_G, whereas the written target of φ_G′ is ΠM_G′. The differing targets and the source label φ_G are retained. No mathematical correction or proof-check event is inferred merely from that notation variation.

Both occurrences of S_C M_G omit Π. The live subscript C is clear in each; the angular old character underneath is tentatively A and remains locally doubtful. H acknowledges that correction in an editorial note but does not preserve the earlier ink in its transcription.

The lower-right Π in (125) overlies a curved trace that crosses its first upright and turns right. The transcription retains a possible overwritten S as deleted and doubtful. Retracing of Π is an explicit alternative, so the old letter and correction status are not asserted as settled. The upper-right Π has a closed loop along its left upright, read as retracing rather than a distinct cancelled letter.

The two parenthetical connectors and the second connector of the composite chain have a short downward endpoint flick and no ordinary two-wing arrowhead. The harpoon/dash alternatives encode the visible endpoint shape; they do not assert a special mathematical class of morphism. Other arrows on the page have visible heads.

The phrase en tant que quotient de G is live and lies within the parenthesis, before à G–G/C. The word tant has normal crossbars, not a cancellation. There is a comma, without a separate full stop, after isom.

The final wording is On a automatique alors la relation de transitivité pour un composé. The visible ending is ue; no ment, abbreviation superscript, or extra letters have been supplied to regularise the grammar. The short hom, without the extra om. of H, is retained.

The original page, native top half and native bottom half were viewed. Eight local crops were created once from the original coordinates recorded in the changes and decisions, enlarged with LANCZOS, autocontrasted and mildly sharpened; all eight were visually inspected. No crop was rotated. Existing d125 was re-viewed to assess the curved underwritten trace; it was not re-cropped. No OCR, outside research, TeX compilation, or mathematical verification was used.

Blind audit retained all first box readings. The lower square label is gamma-f by its two arms and descending loop, and the doubled Z diagonals remain distinct. The neutral composite box clipped the start of i.e.; a supplementary left-context crop (200,1458,1050,1610) supplied the dotted i and e for that adjudication. No prior committed box or first reading was modified.
